title: Rate limiting for the Tidemarsh upload API

sources.content: Proposal: add per-account rate limiting to the Tidemarsh upload API. Today a single account can send unlimited upload requests, and one misconfigured client recently filled the ingest queue for an entire afternoon. The change adds a token bucket for each account that allows 60 upload requests per minute, with bursts of up to 10 extra requests. Limits apply only to the POST /v2/uploads endpoint. Read endpoints are out of scope for this change and keep their current behavior.

Scenario: account exceeds the limit. Given an account has used all of its tokens, when it sends another upload request, then the API returns status 429 with a Retry-After header giving the number of seconds until a token is free. Scenario: limit resets. Given an account was rate limited, when enough time passes for its bucket to refill, then the next upload request succeeds with status 201. Requirement: every rejected request is counted in the uploads_rate_limited_total metric, labeled by account tier.

claims.text: The Tidemarsh token bucket allows 60 upload requests per minute per account.
A rate-limited Tidemarsh upload request receives status 429.
The Tidemarsh rate limits apply to the GET /v2/uploads endpoint.
Rejected Tidemarsh upload requests are counted in the uploads_rate_limited_total metric.
A Tidemarsh upload that succeeds after the bucket refills returns status 200.
Tidemarsh read endpoints keep their current behavior under this change.
